label: Try Our Work
heading: Sirf dekhiye nahi. Khud try kijiye.
description: We build working examples that solve real small-business situations.

items.problem: Customers send enquiries via WhatsApp. Appointments are managed manually.
items.before: The owner manually checks every message and shares availability — during busy hours, enquiries get missed.
items.solution: A simple booking flow: browse services, pick a time slot, and get confirmation and reminders automatically.
items.whyItHelps: Less back-and-forth communication, and the owner doesn't have to manually reply to every message.
items.testimonialQuote: With this kind of booking system, salon owners can see how many bookings they have for the day right when they start — without digging through WhatsApp.
items.testimonialAuthor: Illustrative example, not a real client quote

items.problem: Customers browse products, but enquiring about a specific product isn't easy.
items.before: Customers had to make a separate call or DM to find out the price or availability, which took time.
items.solution: Browse the catalogue, send a direct enquiry on any product, and the team follows up.
items.whyItHelps: Customers get a clear next step instantly, and enquiries never get missed.
items.testimonialQuote: When customers get a clear, instant enquiry option, following up becomes easy — no interested buyer slips through.
items.testimonialAuthor: Illustrative example, not a real client quote

items.problem: Menu, location, and customer information are scattered across different places.
items.before: Customers had to check multiple apps to find the menu, timings, and location.
items.solution: Menu, location, and order/enquiry option on a single page — everything in one place.
items.whyItHelps: Customers get everything in one place, making it easier to decide.
items.testimonialQuote: With everything in one place, customers decide faster — whether it's ordering or visiting, both become easy.
items.testimonialAuthor: Illustrative example, not a real client quote

items.problem: Leads come in from multiple channels and follow-up is managed manually.
items.before: Leads came in through WhatsApp, email, and calls, and it was hard to track which lead still needed follow-up.
items.solution: A simple system that qualifies the lead, books an appointment, and sends a follow-up reminder.
items.whyItHelps: No lead is left without follow-up, and everything is tracked in one place.
items.testimonialQuote: When a lead qualifies itself and books its own appointment, the consultant's time goes only into actual conversations.
items.testimonialAuthor: Illustrative example, not a real client quote
